query: SELECT c.tenant_id, c.id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.tenant_id) o.tenant_id, o.id, o.created_at FROM generation_operations AS o JOIN tenants AS t ON t.id = o.tenant_id WHERE o.state = 'accepted' AND o.next_attempt_at <= now() AND t.state = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS f WHERE f.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND f.state IN ('claimed', 'dispatched')) ORDER BY o.tenant_id, o.created_at, o.id) AS c LEFT JOIN tenant_generation_schedule AS s ON s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id ORDER BY s.last_claimed_at NULLS FIRST, c.created_at, c.id LIMIT 16
